scripts.copy: mkdir -p dist/icons && cp manifest.json dist/manifest.json && cp public/popup.html dist/popup.html && cp public/manage.html dist/manage.html && cp public/content.css dist/content.css && cp public/manage.css dist/manage.css && cp public/icons/*.png dist/icons/
scripts.watch: npm run copy && concurrently "esbuild src/content.ts src/popup.ts src/manage.tsx src/background.ts --bundle --outdir=dist --format=iife --sourcemap --jsx=automatic --watch=forever" "chokidar 'public/**' 'manifest.json' -c 'npm run copy'"
